title: Poor Things (2023) or the bizarre ballad of Bella Baxter

commenti.body:
why did I read this. take your purely descriptive synopsis, as carefully written as it is to letterboxd please or give us a perspective to engage with. 

How about this, what do you make of the hypercritical reviews from women that view it as a titillating misogynistic reductive male fantasy version of Barbie feminism

Hot take: Poor Things achieved what Barbie could only try to. 

I thought the film was a little long, and maybe even crude at times, but the more I think about the movie, the more I like it. It prompted me to consider my own perceptions, and anytime a film does that it’s a great thing.
